instruction: Restock the cup shelf to exactly 2 cups. Restock the block shelf to the user's block_quota, either 2 or 3 blocks. Count current physical contents first and add only the deficit. Do not move already stocked items or surplus spare stock. Cup replenishment is fully specified even before the block quota is known. The user specifies block_quota=2.
